summary: Finalized Master Project Roadmap & Architectural Forensic Plan (v2.1) for Al-Basmi Orth. Incorporates user's four final governance principles: (1) isolated ephemeral sandboxes for fault-injection testing with zero touch of user data, (2) certification based on forensic requirement coverage and assertion rigor beyond simple pass counts, (3) clear architectural role of SQLite as clinical SSOT paired with coordinated media blob stores, and (4) contract-driven mechanism selection without premature commitment to SAVEPOINTs before proving contract capabilities. Stage 0 (V6-FORENSIC-01) is formally authorized as read-only.
